user.title: Link your Smart Life / Tuya Smart account
user.description:
**How this works:** once configured, this integration controls your pump entirely locally, without going through the cloud. Initial setup, however, requires a one-time connection to the Smart Life cloud to automatically retrieve your pump's device ID and local key — you won't need to look them up manually.

Before continuing, make sure your pump has already been added to the Smart Life app, as described in your pump's instruction manual.

Once setup is complete, the Smart Life app is no longer required, unless you wish to keep using it alongside this integration.

**⚠️ Warning:** if you remove and re-add your pump in Smart Life, its local key will change, and you will need to reconfigure this integration accordingly. You may safely delete the Smart Life app from your phone, but **never remove the pump from your Smart Life account**.

**Where to find your user code:** open the Smart Life app → Profile (bottom-right icon) → gear icon (Settings) → Account and Security → User Code.

![How to find your user code](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alray31/gopool-pump/main/docs/images/user_code.gif)

scan.title: Scan this QR code
scan.description:
Open the Smart Life or Tuya Smart app, then tap the scan icon (usually in the top-right corner of the home screen). Scan the code below, confirm on your phone, then press Submit here.

![How to scan the QR code](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alray31/gopool-pump/main/docs/images/qr_scan.gif)

pick_device.title: Select your pump
pick_device.description: Pick the device from your linked account, and enter its local IP address.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the pump locally with these credentials. Check the IP address and that the pump is on the same subnet.
error.login_error: Tuya login failed — check the user code, or the QR code may have expired.

abort.device_list_failed: Could not list devices from your Tuya account after login.
abort.no_devices_found: No device with a usable local key was found on this account.
